just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D#4 and dwells most on Gs in Mokhalef, Pt. 2. The line peaks at B4 (506.9 Hz) at 0:18.1. It closes on Gs4, not the tonic (Gs4 → Gs4 → Gs4 → Gs4 → Gs4 → Gs4).

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes
